name: Elephant
facts: Elephants use their trunks to pick things up.
An elephant's trunk can help it smell and drink water.

name: Giraffe
facts: A giraffe has a very long neck.
Giraffes use their long tongues to reach leaves.

name: Penguin
facts: Penguins are birds that swim very well.
A penguin's feathers help keep it warm.

name: Dolphin
facts: Dolphins breathe air through a blowhole.
